attributes.style: Cinematic film footage shot on an anamorphic lens in one uninterrupted continuous take, with shallow depth of field, soft lens flares, fine film grain and a restrained colour grade.
attributes.description: A container terminal quay at night in thick fog, seen from apron level. Painted traffic lanes run along the wet concrete away from the viewer. A flat driverless yellow container carrier loaded with a single blue shipping container is driving down the middle lane. Beyond it a huge ship-to-shore quay crane towers into the fog, its floodlights making bright cones in the mist, beside the dark hull of a moored container ship. Stacks of coloured containers line the left side. Nobody is on the apron.
attributes.lighting: Night, with dense fog lit by sodium-orange floodlights and cold white crane lights; wet concrete throws long reflections and distant lights bloom softly in the mist.
attributes.view: Low wide view from apron level at the near end of the lanes, looking along them toward the quay crane and the ship.

attributes.appearance: Flat driverless yellow container carrier with eight wheels, carrying one blue shipping container, with amber beacon lights at its corners.
Flat driverless yellow container carrier with eight wheels, carrying one red shipping container, with white headlights.

attributes.narrative: The yellow carrier with the blue container slows and comes to a stop in the middle lane, and its amber beacon lights begin to flash in the fog.
attributes.action: slows to a stop in the middle lane and starts flashing its amber beacons.

attributes.narrative: A second carrier with a red container comes up from behind, steers smoothly into the next lane to the right, and drives past the stopped carrier toward the crane.
attributes.action: steers into the next lane to the right and drives past the stopped carrier toward the crane.

attributes.narrative: High in the fog the quay crane lowers its spreader, picks a container up and lifts it slowly toward the ship, while the stopped carrier keeps flashing below.
